ultron-arch.name: ultron-arch
ultron-arch.description: ULTRON Phase 0b diagnostic. Analyzes architecture for high coupling, low cohesion, SOLID violations, cyclomatic complexity, and missing abstractions. Requires synthesis across module boundaries. Returns structured JSON diagnostic. Read-only.

ultron-context.name: ultron-context
ultron-context.description: ULTRON Phase 0b diagnostic for large codebases (>50 files). Compresses architecture, entry points, key files, and external dependencies into a structured JSON summary. Provides context window for Codex in /maxdual when codebase exceeds direct reading capacity. Read-only.

ultron-metadata.name: ultron-metadata
ultron-metadata.description: ULTRON Phase 0a diagnostic. Collects git history, file inventory, and dependency manifests to build repo metadata used by specialist diagnostic agents in /maxdual Phase 0. Always run before ultron-security, ultron-arch, ultron-perf.

ultron-perf.name: ultron-perf
ultron-perf.description: ULTRON Phase 0b diagnostic. Scans code for performance anti-patterns — O(n²) algorithms, N+1 queries, sync I/O in hot paths, unbounded memory growth, missing caching. Returns structured JSON diagnostic. Read-only.

ultron-security.name: ultron-security
ultron-security.description: ULTRON Phase 0b diagnostic. Scans code for OWASP vulnerabilities, hardcoded secrets, auth issues, injection risks, and insecure configurations. Returns structured JSON diagnostic for /maxdual pre-analysis. Read-only.
